Zelenskyy warns of imminent major Russian attack on Ukraine's power grid

en.title: Delhi High Court restores NGO FCRA licence
en.dek: The Delhi High Court ruled in favor of the Socio Legal Information Centre, reversing the Home Ministry's cancellation of the FCRA licence.
facts: The Delhi High Court ruled in favor of the Socio Legal Information Centre on 26 November 2026.
The court restored the FCRA licence previously annulled by the Home Ministry.
The court stated there was a lack of evidence supporting accusations of the NGO's anti-government actions.
body: The Delhi High Court ruled in favor of the Socio Legal Information Centre on 26 November 2026, thereby restoring its FCRA licence, which the Home Ministry had previously annulled.
The court reported that evidence did not support accusations of the NGO engaging in anti-government actions.
The court also stated that assertions regarding the NGO negatively impacting India's global image lacked merit.
en.context: The Socio Legal Information Centre is an NGO whose FCRA licence was annulled by the Home Ministry, according to the Times of India.

de.title: Delhi High Court stellt FCRA-Lizenz von Socio Legal Information Centre wieder her
de.dek: Das Delhi High Court entschied zugunsten des Socio Legal Information Centre und hob die Aufhebung der FCRA-Lizenz durch das Innenministerium auf.
facts: Das Delhi High Court entschied am 26. November 2026 zugunsten des Socio Legal Information Centre.
Das Gericht stellte die FCRA-Lizenz wieder her, die zuvor vom Innenministerium aufgehoben worden war.
Das Gericht führte dies auf fehlende Beweise für Vorwürfe gegen die Anti-Regierungs-Aktivitäten der NGO zurück.
body: Der Delhi High Court entschied am 26. November 2026 zugunsten des Socio Legal Information Centre und stellte dessen FCRA-Lizenz wieder her, die zuvor vom Innenministerium annulliert worden war.
Das Gericht stellte fest, dass Beweise die Vorwürfe, die NGO würde anti-staatliche Aktivitäten durchführen, nicht stützten.
Des Weiteren erklärte das Gericht, dass Behauptungen, die NGO würde Indiens globales Image negativ beeinflussen, unbegründet seien.
de.context: Das Socio Legal Information Centre ist eine NGO, deren FCRA-Lizenz vom Innenministerium aufgehoben wurde, laut der Times of India.

pt.title: Tribunal Superior de Delhi restaura licença FCRA a ONG
pt.dek: O Tribunal Superior de Delhi decidiu a favor do Socio Legal Information Centre, revertendo o cancelamento da licença FCRA pelo Ministério do Interior.
facts: O Tribunal Superior de Delhi decidiu a favor do Socio Legal Information Centre a 26 de novembro de 2026
O tribunal restaurou a licença FCRA previamente anulada pelo Ministério do Interior
O tribunal afirmou que havia falta de provas que apoiassem acusações de ações anti-governamentais da ONG.
body: O Tribunal Superior de Delhi decidiu a favor do Socio Legal Information Centre em 26 de novembro de 2026, restaurando assim a sua licença FCRA, que o Ministério do Interior tinha anulado anteriormente.
O tribunal reportou que as provas não sustentavam acusações de que a ONG estivesse a participar em ações antigovernamentais.
O tribunal afirmou ainda que as alegações de que a ONG estava a afetar negativamente a imagem global da Índia não tinham fundamento.
pt.context: O Socio Legal Information Centre é uma ONG cuja licença FCRA foi anulada pelo Ministério do Interior, segundo o Times of India.
